description: This file defines a simple-methods XML configuration for a marketing contact import process in the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically managing contact list parties, including permission checking, looping through form data, entity lookups, and service calls.

methods.name: importContactListParties
methods.description: The primary method that handles importing contact list parties, performing permission checks, processing form input, entity lookups, and creating new contact list party entries if they do not already exist.
